title: Explainable row-level data usability: the four required fact dimensions the eligibility row never carried
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE - all 75 MD-B16 mandatory predicates are proven by executed guards. The stage opened at a denominator of 75 rather than the 28 the Stage Register carried, because 41 predicates arrived filed as reference context or as mixed-run siblings while carrying real obligations: the liquidity and status-and-event dimension lists, the decision-and-explanation fields, the prohibition on reconstructing a dimension from an overloaded reason code, the registry-only reason rule, the degraded-behaviour cases and the run-level distinction.

authority_basis.note: MD-B14 closure is a stage precondition only. No MD-B14 predicate proof is inherited: every one of the 75 predicates bound here was proven by a guard executed during this attempt.

execution_environment.schema_drift_note: tradeaxis and tradeaxis_testing both report 80 applied migrations. This attempt added no migration: the remediation binds identities the platform already computed.

required_semantics_proven: Every temporal-universe instrument receives an explicit data-usability row; a missing fact never removes the row or defaults it to usable.
One eligibility row exists per publication, trade date and stable listing identity, including blocked and verified NOT_EXPECTED cases.
Expectation, delivery and canonical availability are persisted as separate dimensions rather than inferred from the decision.
Source and provenance state is on the row, so a traceable observation is distinguishable from an untraceable one without opening the bar table.
Analytical price basis and contamination are two separate dimensions, and an unrecorded basis is never read as a known one.
Indicator validity, warm-up and per-field nullability are explicit, so a warm-up null is distinguishable from an invalid row and from a fully populated one.
No dimension is a delimited composite: packing two facts into one value is the overloading the contract forbids, and the hash serializer refuses it.
eligible = true rows carry the dimension facts as well, so a consumer can see why a usable row is usable rather than only that nothing objected.
The decision consults no liquidity, dormancy or preference input, and zero volume alone never blocks a usable row.
Liquidity and dormancy never change the coverage denominator.
All material blocking reasons are retained in an ordered set; a compatibility primary reason never erases a secondary one.
Only registry-defined reason codes are emitted.
A publication may be readable with ineligible rows, and a held or failed run never exposes its candidate eligibility as readable.
Every new dimension is a protected write field, so a snapshot or promote cannot silently drop it.
Invalid provider rows stay out of canonical bars and contribute to eligibility reasoning only.
data_usable = true is relied on as nothing testable objected, never as a correctness warranty.

coverage.binding: All 75 MD-B16 mandatory predicates are atomically bound to E-MD-B16-A001-001 by MarketDataEligibilitySnapshotProofBinder. The binder refuses a partial binding.

defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.defect: Four required fact dimensions were absent from the eligibility row.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.detail: EOD_Eligibility_Snapshot_Contract_LOCKED.md enumerates the dimensions every row must persist separately and states the consequence without hedging: absence of the first-class facts is a defect against the contract, never a licence to overload reason_code. Seven dimensions were persisted. Source and provenance state, analytical price basis, contamination state, and indicator validity with warm-up and nullability were not - although every input was already in memory when the row was built. A consumer could not tell a traceable observation from an untraceable one, a contaminated window from a clean one, or a warm-up null from an invalid row, without reading the bar and indicator tables, which the acceptance criterion rules out.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.remediation: An additive migration adds four nullable columns to eod_eligibility and eod_eligibility_history, applied to both databases. EodEligibilityBuildService populates them from the bar and indicator rows it already held. The columns reach the canonical schema document, the SQLite mirror, the pipeline column list, the artifact repository, the read product projection and the corpus reconstruction list, and are protected write fields so snapshot and promote cannot drop them. Rows published before the migration keep a null dimension rather than a back-stamped one.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.guard: EligibilityFirstClassFactDimensionsTest, five tests, eight mutation probes all caught.

defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.defect: The first draft of the remediation packed two facts into one delimited value.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.detail: Price basis and contamination were written as a single RAW|CLEAN string. The deterministic hash serializer refused it with HASH_TEXT_DELIMITER_UNESCAPED, which is the same objection the contract makes: a value only its producer can decode is a smaller version of the overloading the contract exists to forbid.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.remediation: Split into price_basis_state and contamination_state, and the migration was rolled back and reapplied on both databases so no intermediate shape survived. A guard now asserts no dimension contains a delimiter.

defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.defect: A proof-map entry named a guard in the wrong class.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.detail: The liquidity family's fail-closed guard was mapped to ActualAndProxyLiquiditySemanticsTest; the method lives in LiquidityMetricLabellingTest. The proof gate reported MISSING_NEGATIVE_PROOF.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.remediation: Repointed to the class that owns the method, before any predicate was bound.
defects_found_and_remediated_in_attempt.guard: MarketDataEligibilitySnapshotProofGate, which verifies every named method exists by name.

residue.scope: The eligibility snapshot build, decision service, expectation resolution, publication projection and replay comparison.
notes: Eligibility rows published before this attempt carry null values in the four new dimensions. They are not back-stamped: writing a dimension onto a row whose producer never recorded it would assert a fact that was never true, and the snapshot contract freezes rows with their publication.
F-MD-B01-A014-001 remains open, owned by MD-B19. F-MD-B14-A001-001 remains open, a reason-code vocabulary matter requiring a strategy change. Neither blocks MD-B16.

no_inheritance_statement: No predicate is claimed on historical material. Every one of the 75 was proven by a guard executed in this attempt, and every guard the attempt relies on was shown to fail under an injected defect.
